reports.title: NextNav Inc. Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results and Operational Highlights

desk.headline: Revenue up 78% to $1.6m, beat; smaller loss than expected on warrant gain; FCC draft rule under review; no guidance
results: Revenue rose 78% to $1.6m, ahead of the $1.0m expected, though still very small.
Operating loss was steady at $19.6m; a $13.0m non-cash gain on warrants cut the net loss to $4.2m ($0.04 a diluted share vs $0.12 a year ago).
Cash and investments of $290.9m and no debt, after converting its notes into shares and warrant exercises earlier in the year.
Field tests of its 5G positioning network in Santa Clara County reached single-digit-metre accuracy indoors and outdoors.
Added sensing partners for drone detection on its 900 MHz spectrum.

guidance.summary: NextNav gives no financial guidance and did not discuss a spending outlook on the call.

points: The FCC has sent a draft proposed rule for its lower 900 MHz band for interagency review; management would not give a timeline.
The CEO pointed to a proposed SpaceX purchase of low-band spectrum from Gray as a sign of how scarce and valuable such spectrum is.
Management said there had not been a single interference claim in its Santa Clara testing; testing with the freight rail industry has concluded.
Partnerships for positioning and drone sensing were presented as proof of wider uses for the spectrum.
